name: pos-accounting-sync
description: Full-Stack Specialty Coffee POS, Inventory & Accounting Reconciliation System (TypeScript, React, Node.js/Express, PostgreSQL)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
